The Ultimate Orientation — every brief names it. The master box — built, and recovery-tested 6 out of 6. The brief checker, the design gate, the numbering guard. The 30-minute loop. The activation checklist, being written now. And here is what is NOT airtight — the evidence, not feelings: the master box went stale on D3 within minutes of the build — refresh is reactive, no automatic refresh rule yet. Four, automatic box provisioning at join. Five, the master box self-refreshing. Six, his eye stops catching what verification should have caught. The ultimate team is the one where his eye never has to catch what verification should have caught. We're not there.
